description: This file contains the server-side code for the TheorySet web page in an online examination system. It includes methods for handling page events, interacting with a SQL database to add questions and exam details, dynamically populating course lists based on selected semester, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the TheorySet ASP.NET page, managing question and exam operations.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains commented-out code for session management.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new question to the 'theoryQS' table and updates the question number display.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Adds exam details to the 'theoryCourseDetail' table and navigates to AdminPanel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course.
